glm-copilot.config.title: GLM Models for GitHub Copilot Chat
glm-copilot.config.apiMode.description:
Use a GLM Coding Plan subscription or the pay-as-you-go Standard API. Both use the endpoint for your `region`.

Get a Coding Plan key from [Z.ai](https://z.ai/manage-apikey/subscription) (International) or [bigmodel.cn](https://bigmodel.cn/coding-plan/personal/overview) (Mainland China).
glm-copilot.config.apiMode.codingPlan.de: Use your GLM Coding Plan subscription. The endpoint depends on `region`: International → `api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4`, Mainland China → `open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4`.
glm-copilot.config.apiMode.standard.desc: Pay-as-you-go access via the GLM Open Platform. The active endpoint is chosen by the `region` setting.
glm-copilot.config.region.description:
Server region for chat and GLM-5.3-Flash image analysis.

- International (Z.ai account): Coding Plan `api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4`, Standard `api.z.ai/api/paas/v4`.
- Mainland China (Zhipu AI account): Coding Plan `open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4`, Standard `open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4`.
glm-copilot.config.region.china.label: Mainland China (bigmodel.cn)
glm-copilot.config.baseUrl.description: Use a custom GLM API base URL for chat and image analysis. Overrides `apiMode` and `region` and skips official API-mode filtering. Older built-in models still require `showLegacyModels`. Custom definitions replace built-ins with the same id. Choose the default model manually for custom endpoints. Image analysis uses this endpoint and the chat key too.
glm-copilot.config.maxTokens.description: Maximum output tokens per request. Set to 0 to use the API default without an explicit limit.
glm-copilot.config.maxRetries.descriptio: Maximum automatic retries for transient chat failures (HTTP 429 rate limits and 5xx server errors), not counting the initial attempt. Set to `0` to disable automatic retries and fail fast. Retries wait with exponential backoff and honor the server's `Retry-After` header.
glm-copilot.config.modelIdOverrides.desc: Remap a built-in model id for a proxy or regional endpoint. Keys are picker ids (e.g. `glm-4.7`); values are the ids sent to the API. Use `customModels` to add models.
glm-copilot.config.customModels.descript: Add your own GLM models to the picker. Each entry is either a model id string (e.g. `"glm-4.7"`) or an object such as `{ "id": "my-model", "name": "My Model", "nativeImageInput": true }`. Custom models always appear regardless of API Mode and are sent to the active endpoint. Set `nativeImageInput` only when the endpoint accepts image content directly; otherwise attached images use GLM-5.3-Flash fallback.
glm-copilot.config.thinking.description: Enable or disable reasoning for models without a per-model Thinking Effort control. GLM-5.2 uses None / High / Max. GLM-5.3, Flash, and FlashX require thinking and use Low / High / Max (Max by default).
glm-copilot.config.visionPrompt.descript: Instruction sent to GLM-5.3-Flash for text-only models. Leave empty to use the built-in prompt, which transcribes visible text and code and describes images without guessing. Analysis uses the chat endpoint and API key. Changing this setting re-analyzes images on the next turn. Open it with [`GLM: Edit Flash Image Analysis Prompt`](command:glm-copilot.openVisionPromptSettings).
glm-copilot.config.debugLogging.descript: Enable verbose debug logging to the GLM output channel. Use [`GLM: Show Logs`](command:glm-copilot.showLogs) to view the channel. Logs may include request metadata but not prompt text.
glm-copilot.config.usageRefreshIntervalM: How often (in minutes) to refresh the GLM usage status bar. Minimum 1, maximum 1440 (24 hours). Shows Coding Plan quota or Standard API balance for both International (z.ai) and Mainland China (bigmodel.cn) regions. Only available when no `baseUrl` override is configured.
glm-copilot.config.showUsageStatusBar.de: Show the GLM usage status-bar item. Displays Coding Plan quota or Standard API balance for both International (z.ai) and Mainland China (bigmodel.cn) regions. Only available when no `baseUrl` override is configured.
